title: Mony Mony (Billy Idol Live Version)
notes: Written by Tommy James and the Shondells, 1968. Covered by Billy Idol in 1981.

sections.name: Intro
sections.annotation: 8 bars, Bass & Drums only, guitar scratch, Vocal ad-lib

So fine Mony Mony
So fine Mony Mony

Yes, I feel alright
